_meta.name: invoice_lens
_meta.title: InvoiceLens — Demurrage / Detention Invoice Extractor
_meta.description: Generative Extraction taxonomy for freight demurrage/detention invoices in the DisputeOps pipeline. Maps invoice PDF fields to the data.schemas.case.Invoice model consumed by the PaperTrail agent.
_meta.provenance: Hand-authored from the DisputeOps Invoice/EvidencePackage Pydantic schemas and the three test-fixture PDFs (empire_freight, pacific_liner, coastal_carrier). This is a source-controlled extraction spec, NOT a live export from a UiPath Document Understanding project — no `uip ixp` CLI is available in this environment, so the taxonomy could not be exported from a deployed model. Use this file as the import payload when creating the project in the DU web portal.

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.instruction: The carrier's invoice identifier, labeled 'Invoice No.'. Example: EMFR-INV-2026-0491. Extract verbatim including the alphanumeric prefix and hyphens.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.instruction: The billing carrier / NVOCC / VOCC name, shown in the letterhead at the top of the page (e.g. 'Empire Freight Lines'). Do NOT use the 'Notify' or 'Shipper' party.

fields.name: bol_number
fields.instruction: Bill of Lading number, labeled 'BOL Number'. Example: EMFR20260401-001.

fields.name: container_number
fields.instruction: ISO container number, labeled 'Container Number', typically 4 letters followed by 7 digits. Example: MEDU9871234.

fields.name: charge_type
fields.instruction: Whether the charge is 'demurrage' or 'detention', labeled 'Charge Type'. Normalize to lowercase. The document header may show 'DEMURRAGE / DETENTION INVOICE' generically — use the specific 'Charge Type' field value, not the header.

fields.name: charge_incurred_date
fields.instruction: Date the charge was incurred, labeled 'Charge Incurred Date'. Example: 2026-05-09.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.instruction: Date the invoice was issued, labeled 'Invoice Date'. Example: 2026-06-25.

fields.name: free_time_start
fields.instruction: Start of the free-time window, labeled 'Free Time Start'. NOTE: the document carries date only; no time-of-day is printed. Downstream defaults the time to 08:00 UTC.

fields.name: free_time_end
fields.instruction: End of the free-time window, labeled 'Free Time End'. Date only; see free_time_start note.

fields.name: published_free_time_days
fields.instruction: Published free time, labeled 'Published Free Time', usually expressed in days (e.g. '3 days' -> 3). Extract the numeric quantity. May be 'N/A' (leave empty).

fields.name: tariff_number
fields.instruction: Tariff identifier, labeled 'Tariff Reference' (prefixed with the word 'tariff'). Extract only the identifier, e.g. 'EMFR-2024-DEM', dropping the leading word 'tariff'.

fields.name: hours_billed
fields.instruction: Number of hours billed, in the Billing Summary description cell. May appear as '56.0 hours' or as 'N.NN days (NN.0 hours)' — always extract the HOURS value, not the days value. Example: from '3.00 days (72.0 hours)' extract 72.0.

fields.name: hourly_rate_usd
fields.instruction: The per-unit rate from the rate column. Header may read 'Per Hour Rate' or 'Per Day Rate'; value carries a '/hr' or '/day' suffix. Extract the numeric amount (strip '$' and the unit suffix). Capture the unit separately if possible.

fields.name: rate_unit
fields.instruction: Whether the rate is per '/hr' or '/day', from the suffix on the rate value and the rate-column header. Caution: the 'Basis for Charge' prose may state a different unit than the billing table (e.g. table says '/day' while prose says '/hour') — prefer the billing-table suffix.

fields.name: total_amount_usd
fields.instruction: Total amount due, labeled 'Total Amount Due', and matching the Amount column. Extract the numeric value without the '$' or thousands separators. Example: 3920.00.

fields.name: billed_to_party
fields.instruction: The party being billed, labeled 'Bill To'. Example: 'Pacifica Apparel Inc.'.

fields.name: basis_for_charge
fields.instruction: Free-text justification under the 'Basis for Charge' heading. Capture the full paragraph verbatim, including any dispute email/URL and tariff references.

fields.name: bol_terms
fields.instruction: Free-text under 'Bill of Lading Terms' — shipper, carrier, port of discharge, container, terms, notify party. Capture the full paragraph verbatim.
